name: directives/apply-value-utilities
description: `@apply` for value-bearing utilities. Mirrors upstream's `expandApplyAtRules.js`: variant-free `@apply <util>` inlines decls into the parent rule; variant-bearing `@apply hover:<util>` / `@apply md:<util>` emits sibling rules with the variants applied to the parent selector. Covers color (with `with_alpha_variable` opacity vars), spacing, sizing, modifier (`/50`), and the responsive at-rule path.
